title: 障害対応の取りまとめ
when: Coordinate the response to an outage, failure or production error

steps.title: 対応責任者（インシデントコマンダー）を指名
顧客影響の範囲を確認
steps.desc: Confirm the scope of customer impact

steps.title: 社内外への一次連絡
steps.desc: Send the first status update to stakeholders
steps.check: Are customers or people outside the engineering team likely affected?

steps.title: 暫定対処（ロールバック等）の判断
steps.desc: Decide on a mitigation such as rollback or feature flag

steps.title: 振り返り（ポストモーテム）を予定
steps.check: Is the failure serious enough that a postmortem should be held?
